top5.why: Male seahorse brood fact is warm, true and subversive; classic engraving suits the shop's best sellers.
Famous painting plus a forecaster's deadpan 'Outlook: unclear' is instantly funny and wearable.
Engraved argonaut with 'Aristotle thought it sailed. It's an egg case.' is a lovely engraving-plus-correction.
Haeckel jellyfish with a dry 'do less' caption fits the best-seller style and has a wry attitude.
Barnacle goose tree engraving is odd, visual and a joke about confident wrong ideas.
